notes.title: Huge Balance Update This Week! [Version 0.3.5]
notes.notes:
We've made some pretty major balance adjustments to improve the feel of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36074401/d81088f4bde21f1f320f2001997a0d98e8b36e75.png

Here's a list of the changes made:

All units have had their health roughly doubled.
Masters now deal 4 damage instead of 3.
Solar Flare now deals 15 damage.
Enemy spawn rates have been drastically reduced.
You now gain 1500 scraps each turn per printer instead of 2500.
Backup Cores now cost 350 scraps instead of 500.
Repair Kits now cost 200 scraps instead of 100.
AI Core prices have been drastically reduced.
You now start the game with 10000 scraps instead of 5000.
Auto Turrets now deal 5 damage instead of 3.
The Focus Beam's base damage is increased to 3 from 2.
Enemy stat cards now show the enemy's health.

notes.title: Overcharged Rework with this week's update! [Version 0.3.4]
notes.notes:
We felt that battery charge was in much need of some improvements, so here's what we've got for you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36074401/25b3680d506a74d5c7cac3b89dfe45ae854d750c.png

Overcharge rework. Previously Overcharged bots are now called fully charged and have the option to expend all of their battery to become Overchargedfor the turn. A fully charged bot still gets the 25% bonus like before and an overcharged bot will now get a 50% boost to their stats. If you get a bot back to fully charged after applying overcharge, the effects will stack to a 75% boost.
Fully charged is now indicated by a bot's battery bar changing colour to yellow.
Fully charged now only requires getting to 100% battery instead of recharge while at 100% battery.
Bots will only lose battery charge once in a turn when changing commands and the battery charge will be refunded if you set it back to the bot's original commands.
Changing a bots commands now not only costs 50% battery but requires having at least 50% battery to expend.

On top of this, there's a few other QOL improvements and bug fixes.

Make sure to check out the Version Log in game for all the details!

notes.title: QOL and Balance Improvements with this week's update! [Version 0.3.3]
notes.notes:
We've got a nice quality of life update this week for you!

With the launch of the Indiegogo campaign we've been pretty busy, so this update mainly contains some quality of life improvements and balance adjustments. The next bi-weekly update will be including some larger content updates, so make sure to stay tuned in for it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36074401/950b09dbd5440e31d071f755340227e60cfb69d6.png

This week's update includes:

 Reduced costs for AI Core unlocks.
 The second 3D Printer is now revealed from the start on a normal game.
 The fast forward button is now turned on by default.

Make sure to check out the Version Log in game to see the full list of changes!

Today's the last day for the early bird pledge tiers! If you haven't made your pledge to the campaign yet, make sure to pop over quickly and get your discount!

Click on the image above to get to the campaign page!

notes.title: Some QOL improvements with this extra update! [Version 0.3.2]
notes.notes:
We've brought a nice quality of life update this week.

The usual bi-weekly update will still be coming out next Monday but we wanted to bring a few quality of life improvements to the game before our Indiegogo launch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36074401/365d1185a9b322b1cba36e52df39ce41b5c7f4b6.png

This week's update includes:

 Enemy Spawning Indicators. With the changes to enemy spawning from the last update, we've added some indicators that will go off when enemies are about to spawn into a room you're in!
 Enemy Stat Cards. You can now right click on an enemy to see their stats and commands, along with some flavor text about the enemy!
 A handful of other smaller improvements. Check out the Version Log in game for all the details!

notes.title: Bot Presets are now Available! [Version 0.3.1]
notes.notes:
We've got an exciting new update for you this week with version 0.3.1!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36074401/d30025711b719ea9e5ce19249e422d56ac8c7de9.png

This update includes:

 Bot Builds added. You can now create Bot Builds which act as a bot preset. This also includes the ability to quick spawn your Bot Build by holding control when clicking on the build.
 Reroll option added to AI Cores. Each slot in an AI core can now be rerolled once at the cost of Scraps.
 A huge variety of gameplay improvements, balance improvements, and bug fixes!

Check out the Change Log in game for all the details!

notes.title: Randomized Unlocks Are Here! [Version 0.3]
notes.notes:
We've got a huge update for you this week with Version 0.3!
 

https://i.imgur.com/XfIR1rk.png

This update includes:


The introduction of randomized starting unlocks!
A new station, the AI Core (pictured above) which functions as a shop to buy new unlocks!
Over 30 new commands! To support the addition of unlocks, a whole bunch of awesome new commands have been added! If you're lucky you may even stumble upon some Hax, which are ultra rare commands!


https://i.imgur.com/w30wHDM.png

With over 2200 people subscribed to the campaign I'm sure we can knock it out of the park!

Don't forgot to tell your friends about Bot Net: Ramshackle Robotics and it's Indiegogo campaign because we can always use as much support as possible!

notes.title: Version 0.2.7 Released!
notes.notes:
The newest update is out! ːsteamhappyː

The regular bi-weekly update will still be coming out next Monday as usual but we had a few things we wanted to get  out this week!

Check out the new features, including:

- A Fast Forward button that can be used to speed up the game at any time!

- Rework of the Teleporter. Now you can choose which units are teleporting!

- Major fixes to pathfinding. There were a handful of issues related to the game's pathfinding that are now ironed out!

- And a few other smaller improvements and bug fixes!

Have fun and let us know what you think about this update!
